name: GPM IMERG Final Run (Daily)
description: A carefully processed daily estimate of rain and snow from satellites and other observations.

name: GPM IMERG Final Run (Half-hourly)
description: Shows how estimated rain and snow changed during each half hour.

name: GPM IMERG Final Run (Monthly)
description: Summarizes estimated precipitation over an entire month.

name: GPM IMERG Early Run
description: A faster first estimate of precipitation that is available sooner than the final version.

name: GPM IMERG Late Run
description: A revised near-real-time precipitation estimate with more satellite inputs than the earliest run.

name: TRMM 3B42 Daily
description: An older satellite-based daily rainfall product from the Tropical Rainfall Measuring Mission.

name: TRMM 3B43 Monthly
description: An older monthly tropical rainfall estimate useful for long time-series studies.

name: GPCP Monthly Precipitation
description: Combines multiple observing systems to estimate precipitation across the globe by month.

name: GPCP Daily Precipitation
description: Estimates daily precipitation over land and ocean using several sources.

name: SMAP L2 Radiometer Half-Orbit Soil Moisture
description: Uses microwave measurements to estimate moisture near the land surface along satellite passes.

name: SMAP L3 Radiometer Global Daily Soil Moisture
description: Maps near-surface soil moisture from SMAP observations in daily global coverage.

name: SMAP L3 Enhanced Soil Moisture
description: Provides gridded surface soil moisture with enhanced spatial detail.

name: SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly Soil Moisture
description: Combines satellite observations with a land model to estimate surface and root-zone soil moisture.

name: SMAP L4 Global Carbon Net Ecosystem Exchange
description: Estimates land carbon exchange using models informed by SMAP and other observations.

name: GRACE Tellus JPL Mascon Land Water
description: Uses gravity changes to estimate shifts in water stored across large land areas.

name: GRACE-FO JPL Mascon Water Storage
description: Continues gravity-based measurements of broad changes in water stored on and below land.

name: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model 3-Hourly
description: Models soil moisture and other land-water conditions using weather information.

name: GLDAS Noah Land Surface Model Monthly
description: Provides monthly averages of modeled soil and land-surface water conditions.

name: NLDAS Noah Land Surface Model
description: Models land moisture and energy across North America.

name: MERRA-2 Land Surface Diagnostics
description: A model-based record of soil and land conditions over time.

name: MODIS Terra Vegetation Indices 250m
description: Uses Terra satellite observations to describe vegetation greenness over repeated periods.

name: MODIS Terra Vegetation Indices 500m
description: Shows vegetation indices at a broader map scale.

name: MODIS Terra Vegetation Indices 1km
description: Provides repeated vegetation observations at a regional scale.

name: MODIS Aqua Vegetation Indices 250m
description: Measures vegetation greenness using Aqua satellite observations.

name: MODIS Aqua Vegetation Indices 500m
description: Offers repeated vegetation indices from Aqua at 500-metre detail.

name: MODIS Terra Surface Reflectance Daily
description: Reports reflected sunlight from land in different wavelengths.

name: MODIS Aqua Surface Reflectance Daily
description: Measures sunlight reflected from land using the Aqua satellite.

name: MODIS Leaf Area Index / FPAR Terra
description: Estimates the amount of leaf cover and sunlight absorbed by plants.

name: MODIS Leaf Area Index / FPAR Aqua
description: Estimates leaf cover and light absorption using Aqua observations.

name: MODIS Land Cover Type Yearly
description: Classifies land into categories such as forests, crops and grasslands.

name: MODIS Nadir BRDF-Adjusted Reflectance
description: Provides a clearer comparison of land colour by accounting for viewing and lighting angles.

name: MODIS Burned Area Monthly
description: Maps where satellite observations indicate land burned during a month.

name: VIIRS Vegetation Indices 500m
description: Shows vegetation greenness derived from newer VIIRS satellite observations.

name: VIIRS Daily Surface Reflectance
description: Measures how land reflects light to help describe surface conditions.

name: HLS Landsat Surface Reflectance
description: Combines harmonized Landsat imagery into analysis-ready surface reflectance.

name: HLS Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance
description: Offers harmonized Sentinel-2 observations to complement Landsat coverage.

name: GEDI Level 2A Elevation and Height
description: Uses space-based laser measurements to describe the height of land and vegetation.

name: GEDI Level 2B Canopy Cover and Structure
description: Uses laser measurements to estimate how dense and layered forests are.

name: GEDI Level 4A Aboveground Biomass
description: Estimates the mass of living vegetation above ground along GEDI observations.

name: ICESat-2 ATL08 Land and Vegetation Height
description: Uses laser observations to estimate terrain and vegetation height.

name: MODIS Terra Land Surface Temperature Daily
description: Estimates the temperature of the land's surface, which is not the same as air temperature.

name: MODIS Aqua Land Surface Temperature Daily
description: Shows daily surface temperature using Aqua measurements.

name: VIIRS Land Surface Temperature Daily
description: Measures temperatures of the land surface using VIIRS instruments.

name: ECOSTRESS Land Surface Temperature
description: Measures detailed land surface temperatures at changing times of day.

name: ECOSTRESS Evapotranspiration
description: Estimates water moving from land and plants into the air.

name: AIRS Daily Air Temperature and Humidity
description: Provides atmospheric temperature and moisture observations from an infrared instrument.

name: AIRS Monthly Air Temperature and Humidity
description: Summarizes AIRS atmospheric measurements by month.

name: OMI Tropospheric Nitrogen Dioxide
description: Estimates nitrogen dioxide in the lower atmosphere from satellite observations.

name: OMI Total Column Ozone
description: Shows the amount of ozone through the full column of atmosphere.

name: MERRA-2 Aerosol Diagnostics
description: Provides modeled estimates of airborne particles such as dust and smoke.

name: MERRA-2 Single-Level Diagnostics
description: Provides a long-running model-based record of near-surface weather conditions.

name: OCO-2 Lite Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide
description: Maps estimates of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere from the OCO-2 satellite.

name: OCO-3 Lite Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide
description: Measures atmospheric carbon dioxide from an instrument on the space station.

name: CERES EBAF TOA Radiation
description: Summarizes energy arriving at and leaving the top of Earth's atmosphere.

name: CERES EBAF Surface Radiation
description: Estimates the energy reaching and leaving Earth's surface.

name: NASA POWER Daily Point Data
description: Gives location-based daily sunlight and weather-related values for planning and research.

name: CERES SYN1deg Daily Radiation
description: Combines satellite data and models to describe daily sunlight and heat energy.

name: CERES SYN1deg Monthly Radiation
description: Offers monthly energy and radiation estimates across the globe.

name: MERRA-2 Radiation Diagnostics
description: Provides a modeled history of solar and other radiation conditions.

name: SRTM Global 1 Arc Second Elevation
description: Maps ground elevation using radar measurements from a space shuttle mission.

name: NASADEM Digital Elevation Model
description: Provides an updated elevation map built from space-based terrain observations.

name: ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model
description: Creates a global map of land elevation using stereo satellite images.

name: ICESat-2 ATL03 Photon Heights
description: Provides laser photon measurements used to measure surfaces on Earth.

name: ICESat-2 ATL06 Land Ice Height
description: Tracks changes in the height of land ice sheets and glaciers.

name: ICESat-2 ATL13 Inland Water Height
description: Estimates heights of lakes, reservoirs and rivers along satellite tracks.

name: MODIS Terra Ocean Chlorophyll
description: Estimates chlorophyll in surface waters, a clue to microscopic plant life.

name: VIIRS Ocean Chlorophyll
description: Shows chlorophyll estimates from VIIRS ocean-colour measurements.

name: GHRSST MUR Sea Surface Temperature
description: Combines observations to make a detailed global map of ocean surface temperature.

name: SMAP Sea Surface Salinity
description: Estimates saltiness of the ocean surface using microwave observations.

name: SWOT Level 2 Lake Water Surface Elevation
description: Uses radar measurements to describe lake water heights and shapes.

name: SWOT Level 2 River Water Surface Elevation
description: Uses radar observations to estimate water heights along rivers.
